notes.title: New Gamemode!
notes.notes:
Introducing - Midnight Carnival

Your goal is to travel to the various locations in this eerie open world and turn on all the generators. You can travel safely on the train or try your luck on foot through the spider-infested forest. Once all the generators are on, you can grab the box of wonders and teleport out of that nightmare! 

p.s. 
Beware of the clowns...

notes.title: AI Update
notes.notes:
- ADJUSTED: Several changes have been made to improve the ai's understanding of space, when to freeze, its ability to locate the player and a mechanism for each AI to seek out a random player every 60 seconds
- ADJUSTED: The player sense frustum has been adjusted to a more limited viewing angle that closely matches the player camera
- ADJUSTED: The scroll to switch equipment is now able to switch equipment even when melee weapon is out
- FIXED:  Bug where there was no walk animation while holding a melee weapon
- FIXED: Bug where the pyramid level sfx wasn't looping
- FIXED: Bug where some decals from various gates were showing in the wrong level

notes.title: Massive Update!
notes.notes:
- In game objectives have been added
- The E key is now for Interact and right click will drop a glowstick
- You can pick up valuable items by interacting and drop them with B (controller also supported)
- To access the scanner/scrap of paper - look down and toggle equipment with scroll wheel
- There is now a Trophy Section, with trophies obtained by completing in game objectives
- Many minor bugs have been resolved

notes.title: Game Just Released!
notes.notes:
Buy or add to your wishlist and join the Official Discord for the full community experience!

In "Don't Panic", you're thrown into mysterious and disorienting mazes with one goal – find your way out. But it's not just the winding paths that stand in your way. Inanimate figures – statues, crash dummies, and other eerie silhouettes – lurk in the shadows, moving closer every time you look away. Will you rely on your trusty flashlight to keep them at bay? Or will you let the compass guide you through, even as everything else tries to throw you off course? Each maze is uniquely generated, ensuring no two runs are ever the same.
